questions.stem: How are you going to pay for it?

options.B: I'll get a pay raise soon.

questions.explain:
pay for: 支付、買單
payday: 發薪日
pay raise: 加薪
解析：題目問「你打算如何付款？」，詢問具體的支付方式，因此答案選D「我要用信用卡」。選項A「等到發薪日」與B「我快加薪了」是利用同字根 pay 設下的字面陷阱，答非所問；C「除非你堅持」則與題意無關。

questions.stem: What is the score?

options.A: The Yankees are leading the Red Sox by two.
options.C: The sport is very popular now.

questions.explain:
score: 比分
lead by: 領先…分
semifinal: 準決賽
解析：題目詢問比賽比分。A表示洋基領先紅襪兩分，符合賽況語境，故答案選A。B僅說明賽程階段（準決賽），C描述運動受歡迎程度，D則是利用store與score發音相近的聽力陷阱。

questions.stem: Are you sure it's genuine?

options.A: I'm sure it belongs to me.
options.B: No way. I have to ask permission first.
options.C: I'm sure it's the lowest price you can get.
options.D: Of course. It's the real thing.

questions.explain:
genuine: 真正的、真品的
real thing: 真品、真貨
解析：題目問「你確定這是真品嗎？」，genuine 表「真品」，與 real thing 同義，故肯定回答它是真貨最恰當，答案選D。選項A回答所有權歸屬、B提到請求許可、C偏向討論價格，皆未回應物品真偽，屬於答非所問的干擾。

questions.stem: Do I need a doctor's prescription to buy the drugs?

options.A: Yes, I'll recommend a good doctor to you.
options.B: No, you cannot practice medicine without a license.
options.C: Yes, I'll give you a general description.
options.D: No, you can get them over the counter.

questions.explain:
prescription: 處方箋
over the counter: 免處方的、成藥
解析：問句意為「我買這些藥需要醫師處方箋嗎？」。over the counter 指不需處方的成藥，故答案選D。選項C的 description 與題目 prescription 發音相近為聽力陷阱；選項A推薦醫生與選項B談論行醫執照皆答非所問。

questions.stem: What's your major?

options.A: I'm not a major. I'm a lieutenant.
options.B: Major Smith will give us a briefing.

questions.explain:
major: 主修、大學專業；少校
lieutenant: 陸軍中尉、少尉
解析：題目問「你的主修是什麼？」，詢問求學專業，答案選C。選項A與B是利用軍職人員熟悉的軍階「少校」設計的一字多義陷阱，答非所問；D則是回答健康或狀態，與提問無關。

questions.stem: How may I help you?

options.B: I'd like to book a return ticket.

questions.explain:
book a ticket: 預訂票券
return ticket: 來回票
解析：題目意為「需要為您服務嗎？」，是櫃檯或客服常見的詢問語。答案選B，回答具體需求「我想訂來回票」才符合情境。選項A、C、D皆是重複題目單字 help 或利用 book 延伸成「書籍」的字面陷阱，答非所問。

questions.stem: Would you like to leave a message?

options.A: Yes, I'll be back in a minute.
options.B: No, I won't leave until you come.
options.C: Yes, you've just got a message.

questions.explain:
leave a message: 留言
call back: 再打來；回電
解析：題意為電話用語「你需要留言嗎？」，答案選D「不用了，我待會再打」，符合對話情境。選項B利用 leave 另一字義「離開」設下字面陷阱；選項A「我馬上回來」與選項C「你剛收到訊息」在語意和邏輯上皆不符。

questions.stem: Are you allergic to anything?

options.A: Yes, seafood does not agree with me.
options.B: No, I don't want to eat anything.
options.C: Yes, ice cream is my favorite food.
options.D: No, I'm not particular about food.

questions.explain:
allergic to: 對……過敏
agree with: （食物）適合體質
be particular about: 講究、挑剔
解析：題目問「你對任何東西過敏嗎？」。片語 agree with 指食物適合體質，否定表示吃了身體不適，符合過敏情境，故答案選A。干擾項B拒絕吃東西，答非所問；C答Yes卻說最喜歡，語意矛盾；D指不挑食，未回答過敏問題。

questions.stem: Is there a minimum age for retirement?

options.D: No, there is no age discrimination here.

questions.explain:
minimum: 最低的、最小值
retirement: 退休
解析：題目詢問「退休是否有最低年齡限制？」，A回答「有，是55歲」正面回答了規定年齡，故答案選A。選項B利用重複字minimum設下最低消費的陷阱；C回答個人退休狀況，答非所問；D則利用重複字age誘答，離題討論年齡歧視。

questions.stem: How is my vision?

options.C: Your view is different from mine.
options.D: You need to pay them a visit.

questions.explain:
vision: 視力
nearsighted: 近視的
slightly: 輕微地
解析：題幹詢問「我的視力如何？」，vision指視力，因此回答近視狀況最合理，答案選B。選項A的television（電視）與D的visit（拜訪）皆為發音或字形相似的干擾陷阱；選項C的view指看法或景色，與視力檢查無關。

questions.stem: How will you go to the airport?

options.B: I'll take a day or two off.
options.C: I'll pick you up at the entrance.
options.D: I'll pick out some gifts for you.

questions.explain:
shuttle bus: 接駁公車
take a day off: 請假一天
pick up: 接送
解析：題意問「你將如何去機場？」，是在詢問交通方式。A回答搭乘接駁車符合情境，故答案選A。B選項用take片語混淆成請假；C選項的接送與D選項的挑選禮物皆答非所問。

questions.stem: Where can I get some yogurt?
questions.explain:
yogurt: 優格
dairy section: 乳製品區
解析：題目詢問哪裡可以買到優格。優格屬於乳製品，在超市應至乳製品區選購，故答案選A。選項B圖書館、C科學博物館、D浴室皆非販賣食品的場所，屬於地點邏輯的干擾項。

questions.stem: Would you care for some beverages?

options.A: I don't care who'll do it.
options.C: I'll leave the baby in her care.

questions.explain:
care for: 想要、喜歡
beverage: 飲料
解析：題目詢問「你想喝點飲料嗎？」，care for 在此是禮貌詢問「想要」。答案選D，回答想喝柳橙汁最符合語境。選項A的「不在乎」與選項C的「照顧」都是利用 care 的一字多義設下的字面陷阱，選項B則是文不對題。

questions.stem: Are you a vegetarian?
questions.explain:
vegetarian: 素食者
vegetable: 蔬菜
eat out: 外食、在外用餐
解析：題意問「你是素食者嗎？」vegetarian指素食者，故答案選D「是的，我只吃蔬菜」。選項A用發音相近的Australian（澳洲人）混淆聽力；B（已吃飽）與C（很少外食）皆答非所問。

questions.stem: What should we do to promote our products?

options.B: Buy them when prices go down.
options.D: Sell them when prices go up.

questions.explain:
promote: 推銷、宣傳
commercial: 電視或廣播廣告
product: 產品
解析：題意問「我們該做什麼來推廣產品」，答案選A，在電視上播廣告符合促銷宣傳的手段。B與D選項提及價格漲跌時買進或賣出，屬於一般交易策略而非推廣手法；C選項的做飯更與題旨完全無關。

questions.stem: Do you have any other facilities in the hotel?

options.B: No, all our prices are fixed.
options.D: No, you are not allowed to smoke in here.

questions.explain:
facility: 設施、設備
sauna: 三溫暖、桑拿
be allowed to: 被允許
解析：題目詢問飯店內是否還有其他「設施」。sauna 指三溫暖，屬於硬體設施，回答切題，故答案選C。干擾選項A談餐飲服務、B談價格固定、D為禁菸規則，皆非針對詢問設施的回應，故不選。

questions.stem: Which of the following can a mechanic do?
questions.explain:
mechanic: 機械師、修車技工
prescribe medicine: 開處方藥
repair vehicles: 維修車輛
解析：題意問技工能做什麼。mechanic 指修車技師，故答案選B。干擾選項為其他職業的職責：A開藥是醫生、C種植作物是農夫、D烹飪是廚師，本題主要測驗常見職業與工作內容的搭配，切勿混淆。

questions.stem: Are you accustomed to living here?

options.A: Yes, we have very different customs.
options.B: Not quite, but I'm getting used to it.
options.C: Yes, I know how to make a living here.
options.D: Not yet, but I'm planning to move here.

questions.explain:
be accustomed to: 習慣於
get used to: 逐漸適應
make a living: 謀生
解析：題意為「你習慣住在這裡了嗎？」be accustomed to 等同於 get/be used to，故答案選B（還沒，但我正逐漸適應）。A選項用風俗（customs）作同字根干擾；C選項用 living 延伸成謀生作字面陷阱；D選項說打算搬來，與題目已住在此處矛盾。

questions.stem: Where should I report a theft?
questions.explain:
theft: 竊盜案、偷竊
report: 報案、報告
on a daily basis: 每天、日常
解析：題意為「我應該去哪裡報案失竊？」，疑問詞 Where 詢問地點，故答案選C（去警察局）。干擾選項 A 為時間頻率（每天）、B 為狀態（以穩定的速度）、D 為方式手段（用同樣的方法），皆非回答地點，屬於答非所問的文意陷阱。

questions.stem: Are you done with the computer?

options.A: Yes, we do everything on computer.
options.B: No, I don't need a computer.
options.C: Yes, you may use it now.
options.D: No, I won't have anything to do.

questions.explain:
be done with: 用完、完成
may: 可以、許可
解析：題意為「你電腦用完了嗎？」問句詢問是否結束使用，回答「用完了，你現在可以用」符合語境，故答案選C。選項A與D利用done和do的字面關聯混淆且答非所問；選項B回答No卻接不需要電腦，前後邏輯矛盾。

questions.stem: How are you going to celebrate your wedding anniversary?
questions.explain:
celebrate: 慶祝
wedding anniversary: 結婚週年紀念日
throw a party: 舉辦派對
解析：題目詢問「你們打算如何慶祝結婚週年？」，針對慶祝方式提問，故答案選C「我們會辦派對」。選項A「我們會等你」、B「不會忘記你的」、D「不會讓你失望」皆答非所問、文不對題。

questions.stem: Is the training very difficult for you?

options.C: Yes, it's a very difficult question.
options.D: No, I won't take the train.

questions.explain:
training: 訓練
drive someone crazy: 使某人發瘋、受不了
解析：問句詢問「這項訓練對你來說很困難嗎？」，A用「快把我逼瘋了」生動形容訓練極具挑戰性，語意最契合，故答案選A。干擾項C把主題偷換成難以回答的「問題(question)」；D則是利用 training 與火車(train)的聲音陷阱混淆視聽，皆不符合題意。

questions.stem: What's your sign?

options.A: I signed an agreement with them.
options.B: I'm a Libra. What about you?
options.C: It was a sigh of relief.
options.D: It has my name on it.

questions.explain:
sign: 星座
Libra: 天秤座
sigh of relief: 鬆了一口氣
解析：What's your sign? 意為「你是什麼星座？」，在此 sign 指 zodiac sign，故回答天秤座最合理，答案選B。選項A將 sign 誤作動詞「簽名」；選項C是用發音相近的 sigh（嘆氣）作聽力陷阱；選項D則把 sign 誤解為實體的標記或簽名。

questions.stem: Did I do anything wrong, officer?

options.A: You may order anything you like.
options.B: You were running a red light.

questions.explain:
run a red light: 闖紅燈
officer: 警官、員警
解析：駕駛被攔下詢問「員警，我做錯什麼了嗎？」，答案選B，對方告知違規原因「你剛闖紅燈了」。A項的anything與D項的wrong皆為字面重複干擾，D意為打錯電話，均不合攔檢情境。

questions.stem: Who's in charge of this artillery company?

options.D: Ms. Greenfield is the company manager.

questions.explain:
in charge of: 負責、掌管
artillery: 砲兵
company: 連（軍事編制）；公司
解析：題意為「誰負責這個砲兵連？」針對Who提問且指軍事單位，由上尉回答最合理，答案選B。干擾項D將連級單位company誤解為商業「公司」；C則是借砲兵連英文別稱battery延伸為「電池」的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: Going abroad can help broaden your horizons.

options.A: It can enrich your life and experience.
options.B: It can do good to your health.
options.C: It can increase your job opportunities.
options.D: It can add years to your life.

questions.explain:
go abroad: 出國
broaden one's horizons: 開拓視野
enrich: 豐富、充實
解析：題意為出國有助於開拓視野。broaden one's horizons 意指拓展見識，與A選項「豐富生活與經驗」意思相符，故答案選A。BCD選項提及健康、工作機會或延年益壽，皆為過度推論的內容干擾，並非原句要表達的核心意思。

questions.stem: We are running out of ammunition.
questions.explain:
run out of: 用盡、耗盡
ammunition: 軍火、彈藥
bullet: 子彈
解析：題意為「我們的彈藥快用光了」。ammunition指彈藥，bullet為子彈，彈藥不足即代表需要更多子彈，故答案選C。選項D利用 running shoes（慢跑鞋）混淆題幹的 running out of，屬於字面陷阱；選項A（鼓勵）與B（飲用水）則語意不合。

questions.stem: They may launch an attack at dawn.

options.A: They may launch an attack at daybreak.
options.B: They may launch an attack at midnight.
options.C: They may launch an attack at noon.
options.D: They may launch an attack at sunset.

questions.explain:
launch an attack: 發動攻擊
dawn: 黎明、拂曉
daybreak: 黎明、破曉
解析：題意為「他們可能會在拂曉時發動攻擊」。dawn 與 daybreak 為同義詞，皆指天剛亮的時候，故答案選A。其餘選項皆為時間詞彙陷阱：B為午夜、C為正午、D為日落，均與原句時間不符。

questions.stem: I wish I could remember her name.

options.A: Her name is easy to remember.
options.B: Her name reminds me of one of my friends.
options.C: I've reserved a table in her name.

questions.explain:
wish: 但願（表與事實相反）
remember: 記得
remind: 使想起、提醒
解析：題目用 wish + could 假設語氣表示與現況相反的願望，意為「真希望我記得她的名字」，實際上代表「我記不得」，故答案選D。選項A意思相反；選項B使用字形相近的 remind 製造陷阱；選項C扯到無關的以某人名義訂位。

questions.stem: It's anything but easy to kick a habit.

options.A: To develop a habit is very difficult.
options.B: To pursue a hobby is very easy.
options.C: To break a habit is very difficult.
options.D: To keep a hobby is very easy.

questions.explain:
anything but: 絕不、一點也不
kick a habit: 戒除習慣
解析：題意指改掉習慣絕非易事。kick a habit 等同 break a habit，anything but easy 表示絕不容易即非常困難，故答案選C。選項A的 develop（養成）意思相反；B與D則是用發音與字形相近的 hobby（嗜好）混淆 habit，皆為陷阱。

questions.stem: All the drinks are on the house today.

options.A: All the drinks are on sale today.
options.B: All the drinks are free today.
options.C: They won't provide any drinks today.
options.D: They are still in business today.

questions.explain:
on the house: 店家免費招待
on sale: 特價促銷
解析：題幹中的 on the house 是常用片語，意思是「店家招待、免費」，因此答案選B。選項A的 on sale 是「特價」，兩者容易因都有介系詞 on 而混淆，但特價並非免費；選項C與D則與題意完全不符。

questions.stem: Colonel Jackson may have to undergo surgery.

options.A: He may need a long vacation.

questions.explain:
Colonel: 上校
undergo: 經歷、接受
surgery: 外科手術
operation: 手術
解析：題意為「傑克森上校可能必須動手術」。surgery 與 operation 均指外科手術，語意相通，故答案選B。選項C的 secretary（秘書）與選項D的 itinerary（行程）是利用發音與 surgery 相近製造的聽力混淆項，選項A的 vacation（休假）則與題意無關。

questions.stem: It's a rescue mission.

options.A: The mission is to save people.
options.B: The mission is to transport people.
options.C: The mission is to attack enemies.
options.D: The mission is to mislead enemies.

questions.explain:
rescue: 救援、拯救
mission: 任務
save: 拯救、救助
解析：題目意為「這是一項救援任務」。單字 rescue 與選項 A 的 save 同義，皆表示拯救，因此答案選A。其餘選項 B 的 transport（運輸）、C 的 attack（攻擊）與 D 的 mislead（誤導）皆與救援無關，為軍事行動常見動詞的語意干擾。

questions.stem: I'm fed up with your attitude.

options.B: I can no longer tolerate your attitude.
options.C: I'm in doubt about your attitude.

questions.explain:
fed up with: 受夠了、感到厭煩
tolerate: 忍受、容忍
attitude: 態度
解析：題意為「我受夠了你的態度」。片語 fed up with 表示厭煩且無法再忍受，與 B 的 can no longer tolerate 同義，故答案選B。干擾選項 A 的 satisfied（滿意）與題意完全相反；C 的 in doubt（懷疑）與 D 的 understand（理解）均非受夠之意。

questions.stem: Your heroic acts will go down in history.

options.A: You should do some historical research.
options.B: You may learn a lot from history.
options.C: People will remember you as a hero.
options.D: People will judge you by your acts.

questions.explain:
heroic: 英勇的
go down in history: 名留青史、載入史冊
解析：題意為「你的英勇事蹟將會名留青史」。片語 go down in history 指被後世永遠銘記，與 C 選項「人們會將你作為英雄記住」語意完全相符，故答案選C。選項 A、B 僅利用題目出現的 history 設下字面陷阱，偏離讚譽之意；D 則是斷章取義 acts，皆非正解。

questions.stem: I'm just browsing.
questions.explain:
browse: 隨意瀏覽、隨便看看
hum: 哼唱、發出嗡嗡聲
wait one's turn: 等候輪到自己
解析：題目 I'm just browsing 常見於商店購物情境，店員上前詢問時客人回答「我只是隨便看看」，browse 與 look 同義，故答案選A。選項B為分享經驗、選項C為哼歌、選項D為依序等候，皆是常見動作動詞的語意干擾，與逛街瀏覽商品無關。

questions.stem: You are wasting your breath trying to persuade me.

options.A: The way you talk is very impressive.
options.B: I think you are very persuasive.
options.C: The way you breathe is not right.
options.D: I don't think you can persuade me.

questions.explain:
waste one's breath: 白費口舌
persuade: 說服
解析：題意為「你想說服我是在白費唇舌」。waste one's breath 指白費力氣說話、徒勞無功，表示你不可能說服我，故答案選D。選項C把 breath 誤解為生理上的「呼吸」，屬於字面陷阱；選項A與B認為對方很有說服力，與原意完全相反。

questions.stem: Nick flunked chemistry last semester.

options.A: He did not pass the chemistry exam.
options.B: He got the highest grade in the class.
options.C: He was very interested in chemistry.
options.D: He took the course only last semester.

questions.explain:
flunk: 不及格、被當
chemistry: 化學
semester: 學期
解析：題幹意為「尼克上學期化學被當」。動詞 flunk 表示考試或科目不及格，等同於 did not pass，故答案選A。選項B說他拿最高分，與原意完全相反；選項C談論興趣、選項D強調只修了一學期，皆與不及格無關，屬於無關干擾項。

questions.stem: The coast is clear now.

options.A: The meaning is very clear to me.
options.B: It is safe now to take action.
options.D: It is the cost we worry about.

questions.explain:
coast is clear: 警報解除、沒有危險
take action: 採取行動
解析：The coast is clear為常見片語，指「警報解除、沒有危險」，表示現在安全可採取行動，故答案選B。選項A和C是利用clear字面上「清楚」或「放晴」的陷阱；選項D則是coast與cost發音相近的聽力陷阱。

questions.stem: We'll make up for your loss.
questions.explain:
make up for: 補償、彌補
compensate for: 補償、賠償
evaluate: 評估
解析：題幹表示「我們會彌補你的損失」。片語 make up for 等同於 compensate for，意為彌補或賠償，故答案選C。選項 A（評估）、B（道歉）與 D（同情）雖然常出現在損失的情境中，但並非實質賠償的動作，屬於語義干擾選項。

questions.stem: I've been under a lot of stress recently.

options.A: I have made a lot of progress recently.
options.B: I have suffered from a lot of pressure recently.
options.C: I have changed my address twice recently.
options.D: I have been less busy recently.

questions.explain:
under a lot of stress: 承受極大壓力
suffer from: 遭受、受...之苦
pressure: 壓力
解析：題意為「我最近承受很大的壓力」。stress 與 pressure 為同義詞，故答案選B。選項A的 progress（進步）與選項C的 address（地址）皆為尾音相近的聽力發音陷阱；選項D表示最近比較不忙，與原意相反。

questions.stem: Children at this age are curious about almost everything.

options.A: Children at this age are very naughty.
options.B: Children at this age are likely to get sick.
options.C: Children at this age want to know about many things.
options.D: Children at this age depend on parents for everything.

questions.explain:
curious about: 對...感到好奇
at this age: 在這個年紀
解析：題意為「這年紀的孩子對幾乎所有事都很好奇」。curious 表示好奇，與 want to know 同義，故答案選C。選項A的 naughty（頑皮）、B的 get sick（生病）及D的 depend on（依賴）皆非題目原意，純屬語意延伸的干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: Jenny's father is in the Intensive Care Unit.
questions.explain:
Intensive Care Unit: 加護病房
critical condition: 情況危急
解析：題意為「珍妮的父親在加護病房」。住進加護病房代表病情危急，故答案選A。選項B「情況穩定」、C「完全康復」與D「已經出院」，皆與需要住在加護病房的嚴重情境完全相反，屬於語意矛盾的干擾選項。

questions.stem: A lot of celebrities were present.

options.A: A lot of activities were going on.
options.B: A lot of celebrations were going on.
options.C: A lot of famous people were there.
options.D: A lot of presents were sent.

questions.explain:
celebrity: 名人
present: 出席的、在場的
解析：題意為「許多名人都出席了」。celebrities 等於 famous people，were present 等於 were there，故答案選C。選項B的 celebrations（慶祝活動）是發音相近陷阱；選項D的 presents 則是字面陷阱，將形容詞「在場的」混淆為名詞「禮物」。

questions.stem: Let's take a break.

options.B: Let's look at the broken part.

questions.explain:
take a break: 休息一下
rest: 休息
broken: 損壞的
解析：題意為「我們休息一下吧」。片語 take a break 與 take a rest 同義，故答案選A。選項B利用 break 的同根詞 broken（損壞的）作字面干擾；選項C為祈禱、D為拿行李，皆與題意休息無關。

questions.stem: My younger brother is crazy about online games.

options.A: He is very good at online games.
options.B: He is tired of playing online games.
options.C: He has stopped playing online games.
options.D: He likes online games very much.

questions.explain:
be crazy about: 熱衷於、非常喜歡
be tired of: 對……感到厭倦
be good at: 擅長於
解析：題幹說明弟弟對線上遊戲很著迷，片語 be crazy about 意為極度喜愛，與 D 的 like very much 意思相同，故答案選D。干擾選項 A 的「擅長」屬於過度推論，喜歡不代表技術好；選項 B 的「厭倦」與選項 C 的「停止遊玩」皆與熱衷的題意完全相反。

questions.stem: Check out the manual before using it.

options.A: Pay attention to the warnings on the wall.
options.B: Check out of the hotel before noon.
options.C: Read the instructions when you're about to use it.
options.D: Give it a shake before using it.

questions.explain:
check out: 查看、檢查
manual: 使用手冊
instructions: 操作說明
解析：題意為「使用前請先查看使用手冊」。manual 與 instructions 同義，皆指說明書，check out 在此指查看閱讀，故答案選C。選項B利用 check out 常見的「退房」意思設下字面陷阱；選項A的牆上警告及選項D的搖晃皆偏離原意。

questions.stem: Sergeant Lee will give you a lift.

options.A: Sergeant Lee will give you a ride.
options.B: Sergeant Lee will help you out.
options.C: Sergeant Lee will give you a present.
options.D: Sergeant Lee will cover for you.

questions.explain:
give someone a lift: 順便載某人一程
give someone a ride: 順便載某人一程
cover for: 替某人代班、掩護
解析：題意為「李中士會順道載你一程」。片語 give someone a lift 與 give someone a ride 意思完全相同，故答案選A。選項B利用 lift 字面有「舉起、協助」之意設計成幫忙，為字面陷阱；C為送禮物，語意不符；D為軍中常見的掩護或頂替，皆非正確意思。

questions.stem: The new iPhone is all the rage now.
questions.explain:
all the rage: 十分流行、風靡一時
affordable: 負擔得起的
durable: 耐用的
解析：題幹中的 all the rage 為固定片語，意思是「極為流行、蔚為風潮」，與 very popular 語意相同，故答案選 D。干擾選項 A 的昂貴、B 的價格親民以及 C 的耐用度，皆為針對新手機特點設計的常識陷阱，與片語真正的流行意涵無關。

questions.stem: The ground water around here is not drinkable.

options.A: The ground water is not polluted.
options.B: The ground water is not safe to drink.
options.C: The ground water contains a lot of minerals.
options.D: The ground water can be used for irrigation.

questions.explain:
ground water: 地下水
drinkable: 可飲用的
解析：題意為「這裡的地下水不能飲用」。drinkable 為可飲用的，not drinkable 即表示喝了不安全，故答案選B。選項A說「沒被污染」與原意完全相反；選項C「含豐富礦物質」與選項D「可用於灌溉」皆為題目未提及的過度推論干擾項。

questions.stem: M: How do you know John is cheating on you? W: I have a sixth sense about this. Q: How does the woman know John is cheating on her?

turns.t: How do you know John is cheating on you?
I have a sixth sense about this.
How does the woman know John is cheating on her?

questions.explain:
cheat on: 對...劈腿、不忠
sixth sense: 第六感
intuition: 直覺
解析：女士回答我有第六感（sixth sense），同義於選項B的 intuition（直覺），故答案選B。干擾項A的 common sense（常識）是利用 sense 設計的字面陷阱；選項C與D提及電視頻道與八卦小報，對話中皆完全未提及。

questions.stem: M: You've got a driver's license, haven't you? W: Yes, but I'm still all thumbs when it comes to driving. M: You need to be on the road more often. Q: What does the man mean?

options.B: The woman should drive a better car.
options.C: The woman needs to renew her license.
options.D: The woman should use her legs, too.

turns.t: You've got a driver's license, haven't you?
Yes, but I'm still all thumbs when it comes to driving.
You need to be on the road more often.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
all thumbs: 笨手笨腳的
on the road: 開車上路
解析：女士表示自己開車笨手笨腳，男士建議她多上路，代表需要多練習，故答案選A。選項B換好車與C換發駕照對話中皆未提及；D則是從thumbs字面延伸到legs的無關干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: M: You look upset. What's wrong? W: I accidentally deleted my files. M: What happened? W: I spilled a cup of coffee on my keyboard. Q: Where are the woman's files?

options.A: She left them in a coffee shop.
options.C: She put them back on her desk.
options.D: They are still on the computer.

turns.t: You look upset. What's wrong?
I accidentally deleted my files.
What happened?
I spilled a cup of coffee on my keyboard.
Where are the woman's files?

questions.explain:
accidentally: 不小心地
delete: 刪除
spill: 潑灑
解析：女子因打翻咖啡誤刪了電腦檔案，代表檔案全都不見了，故答案選B。選項A以coffee製造咖啡店的字面干擾；選項D則與已刪除的事實完全相反。

questions.stem: W: The washing machine broke down this morning. M: Is it still under guarantee? W: Of course. We bought it only last month. M: Then they'll fix it for free. Q: What does the man mean?

options.A: The washing machine should be thrown away.
options.B: They must get a refund from the manufacturer.
options.C: The washing machine will be fixed at no cost.
options.D: They must not use the machine too often.

turns.t: The washing machine broke down this morning.
Is it still under guarantee?
Of course. We bought it only last month.
Then they'll fix it for free.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
break down: 故障
under guarantee: 在保固期內
for free: 免費
解析：男士說「they'll fix it for free」（會免費修理），for free 與 at no cost 同義，故答案選C。干擾選項 A 丟棄、B 要求退款及 D 減少使用皆屬過度推論且偏離對話文意。

questions.stem: M: It looks like we need to send more troops to the border now. W: How is the war going on, sir? M: The fighting on the border is escalating. Q: What does the man mean?

options.A: The war has been going on for two months.
options.B: The fighting on the border is becoming more serious.
options.C: He is going to withdraw some of the troops.
options.D: He is going to call a halt to the fighting.

turns.t: It looks like we need to send more troops to the border now.
How is the war going on, sir?
The fighting on the border is escalating.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
escalate: 擴大、加劇
border: 邊境、邊界
withdraw troops: 撤軍
解析：男士提到邊境戰況正在擴大（escalating），代表衝突變得更嚴重，答案選B。選項C的撤軍與選項D的停火，皆與文中要增派部隊（send more troops）的意思完全相反，為語意矛盾的干擾選項；選項A提及的「兩個月」在對話中則完全未出現。

questions.stem: W: Do you have anything to declare? M: I have three cartons of cigarettes. W: Anything else? M: No, that's all. Q: Where is the man?

turns.t: Do you have anything to declare?
I have three cartons of cigarettes.
Anything else?
No, that's all.
Where is the man?

questions.explain:
declare: 申報（海關）
carton: （香菸）條、紙盒
解析：海關人員詢問有無物品要申報（declare），男子回答帶了三條香菸，此為機場入境通關的常見情境，故答案選D。選項A購物中心、B電影製片廠與C遊樂園皆無海關申報程序，純屬無關地點的干擾選項。

questions.stem: M: How do I look in this new shirt? W: It looks a bit tight on you. M: I think I need to shed a few pounds. Q: What does the man mean?

options.A: He needs to lose some weight.
options.B: He needs to spend more money.
options.C: He needs to tighten his belt.
options.D: He needs to try on the shirt.

turns.t: How do I look in this new shirt?
It looks a bit tight on you.
I think I need to shed a few pounds.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
shed a few pounds: 減重、瘦身
tight: 緊的、緊身的
lose weight: 減肥
解析：男士新襯衫穿起來太緊，因此說自己該「shed a few pounds」（減掉幾磅），意思就是減重，故答案選A。干擾項B將重量單位pound誤導為貨幣英鎊；C則是借用tight設計的字面陷阱（tighten one's belt意為節衣縮食），皆非正解。

questions.stem: W: Why can't you stay home and keep me company? M: But going fishing is my only hobby. W: All right. Get your gear and go. Q: What did the woman tell the man to do?

options.A: Change his hobby into a profession.
options.D: Take his equipment and go fishing.

turns.t: Why can't you stay home and keep me company?
But going fishing is my only hobby.
All right. Get your gear and go.
What did the woman tell the man to do?

questions.explain:
keep someone company: 陪伴某人
gear: 裝備、用具
解析：女士原本抱怨男士不陪她，男士稱釣魚是唯一嗜好，女士最後妥協說「Get your gear and go」，gear在此指裝備，故答案選D。選項B留家修理與C做家事為「留在家」的字面延伸干擾，A提及轉為職業屬過度推論，皆非女士最後的指示。

questions.stem: W: What are your men doing over there, sir? M: They're going to explode a bridge. W: Isn't it very dangerous? M: Yes, but I've told them to take cover. Q: What does the man mean?

options.A: He has told them to cover the bridge.
options.B: He has told them to play bridge.
options.C: He has told his second-in-command to take over.
options.D: He has told them to seek shelter.

turns.t: What are your men doing over there, sir?
They're going to explode a bridge.
Isn't it very dangerous?
Yes, but I've told them to take cover.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
take cover: 尋找掩護、避難
seek shelter: 尋求掩蔽
take over: 接替、接管
解析：長官提到引爆炸彈很危險，但他已交代人員take cover（就掩蔽），與seek shelter同義，故答案選D。選項A為cover字面陷阱；B將橋樑bridge誤解為玩「橋牌」；C則是利用音近的take over（接管）混淆聽力。

questions.stem: W: Where's everybody? M: Most people are in the mess hall now. W: Oh, yes. It's already noon. Q: What are most people doing?

turns.t: Where's everybody?
Most people are in the mess hall now.
Oh, yes. It's already noon.
What are most people doing?

questions.explain:
mess hall: 軍中餐廳
noon: 中午、正午
patrol: 巡邏
解析：對話中男士說大家都在餐廳（mess hall），女士回應已經中午（noon），因此可推論眾人正在吃午餐，答案選C。選項A吃早餐時間不對；選項B運動與D巡邏雖為軍中常見作息與勤務，但與餐廳地點不合，屬於情境干擾選項。

questions.stem: Jane suggested that Bill _______ some lemon juice onto the fish before eating.
questions.explain: …suggest that...(should)可省略+ Vr...

questions.stem: _______ sorry, or I won't forgive you for the rest of my life.
questions.explain:
Talk to someone., Tell someone about something., Say a word., Speak a
language.

questions.stem: It will be a few more days _______ the caterpillar emerges from its cocoon.
questions.explain: 表order (順序): after/before, 根據題意, 選before

questions.stem: Jenny _______ her new car while she was backing it into the garage.
questions.explain: sprain: 扭, scrape:擦磨, snap:驟然斷裂, switch:轉.

questions.stem: The prize will go to _______ writes the best essays.
questions.explain:
‘_ writes the best essays.’是n clause, 當'to'受詞, n. clause中V前應該是S (主
詞), 所以選whoever, whoever = anyone / everyone who

questions.stem: _______ God bless our homeland forever!
questions.explain: May + O (受詞)+ Vr: 祝，願…

questions.stem: Every time she rides her motorcycle, she never _______ to wear a helmet.
questions.explain: fail to Vr = not able to…不能…

questions.stem: The Grand Hotel, _______ I stayed last week, is nice and comfortable.
questions.explain:
Grand hotel為地方,故選關係代名詞 'where', 也可改寫為The Grand Hotel,
which I stayed in last…

questions.stem: You _______ have come at a more convenient time. I've just finished everything.
questions.explain: You couldn’t have come at a more convenient time.你來得正是我方便的時候

questions.stem: Todd looks angry. Don't _______ fuel to fire by laughing at him.
questions.explain: add…to…加...到…

questions.stem: Nana is only working here temporarily _______ she is going to move to Miami soon.
questions.explain: cause-reason (結果/原因), 故選conj (連接詞)'because'.

questions.stem: It is _______ that Sergeant Lewis is going to quit next year.
questions.explain: rumor:謠傳,當V時,常用被動。

questions.stem: The president was quoted _______ saying that he would call an emergency meeting.
questions.explain: 「消息來源 + was/ were quoted as saying」(被動語態)為固定用語

questions.stem: _______ was our coach's pride that he would not admit defeat.
questions.explain: Such…that…可改寫成Our coach is so pride that he would…

questions.stem: Although hardly heard of years ago, this town is becoming known _______ a holiday resort.
questions.explain:
…known as + something；…known for... = …be famous for...；…known by
someone.
…known as a holiday resort:以一個度假勝地為大眾所知。

questions.stem: You should _______ immediate action to handle the situation before it's too late.
questions.explain: take action: 採取行動

questions.stem: In many big cities, Tokyo _______, noise pollution has become a very serious problem.
questions.explain:
concluded: 被包括在內的, 此句可改寫: In many big cities, including Tokyo,
noise…

questions.stem: Lt. Col. Smith made _______ clear that such a situation shouldn't be allowed to happen again.
questions.explain: 'it'是假O, 真正O: 'that such a situation shouldn’t be allowed to happen again'

questions.stem: Why not _______ the army and fight for your mother country?
questions.explain: Why not + Vr (動詞原型)

questions.stem: According to the personnel manager, all job applicants are required to be computer _______.
questions.explain: literal:逐字的；literate:能讀寫的；literary:文學的、文藝的；literature:文學

questions.stem: The hygiene of the food stand looks _______, so you'd better not try the food there.
questions.explain:
curious:好奇的, dubious = doubtful可疑的, various:不同的, fabulous =
tremendous極好的

questions.stem: It's unbelievable _______ they've had five wins in a row.
questions.explain: ‘that... n. clause(名詞子句)’是真正主詞, 通常以it作假主詞。

questions.stem: Many governments around the world have _______ a ban on the trade of ivory.
questions.explain: impose:強加在…, improve: 改進, import: 進口, impress: 使感動；深刻影響

questions.stem: That laboratory _______ strongly of chemicals, so I didn't like going there.
questions.explain:
look, sound, smell, taste, feel的用法特点: 以'主動'表'被動' The material felt
nice. The food tasted good.

questions.stem: I tend to overeat _______ I have a buffet lunch with my friends.
questions.explain: 表時間conj. ‘whenever’ = any /every time when…

questions.stem: Vicky is _______ to me because she joined the company much earlier.
questions.explain:
senior to…:年長的、年資較深的、前輩；junior to…年紀較輕的、資淺的、晚
輩的

questions.stem: In a democracy, we should be _______ of other people's opinions although we don't have to agree with them.
questions.explain:
respectable:可敬的、聲譽好的；respectful:恭敬的、謙恭的；respective:個
別的

questions.stem: Since Christmas is _______, a lot of people are busy doing their shopping.
questions.explain:
at stake: 在勝敗關頭，冒風險, at present = right now現在, at hand:即將到
來， at will = freely隨意地，任意地。

questions.stem: Wheat must be _______ into flour before it can be made into bread or cakes.
questions.explain: grind [graɪnd]: 磨（碎）；碾（碎）, grind-ground-ground

Given that...「在這種情況/條件下，還能夠...」、「區區...還能夠；只有...卻
還能...」

questions.stem: The children _______ on the sofa were watching cartoons with great gusto.
questions.explain:
seat是及物動詞，比較正式，常以被動形式表示主動意義, sit通常作不及物動
詞用，比較口語化。此句可改寫: The children sitting on...

questions.stem: Well, you may take Mr. Richardson's advice. Whatever he says _______ sense.
questions.explain: 'Whatever he says'是S, 視為第三人稱單數, 故選makes.

questions.stem: I'll make some sandwiches in case you _______ hungry later.
questions.explain: get hungry = be hungry

questions.stem: In an El Niño phenomenon, the surface water in the eastern Pacific Ocean, near the coast of Peru, gets unusually warm. "El Niño" is Spanish for "Christ Child," since the warming occurs around Christmas. Rainfall seems to follow the warm water, so the areas around Peru get floods. But the weather change doesn't stop there. Regions to the west of the warm water, such as Australia, suffer from little rain. What does Australia suffer from in an El Niño situation?
questions.explain:
drought: 乾旱
flood: 水災
famine: 饑荒
解析：題意問澳洲在聖嬰現象時會遭受什麼。文中指出澳洲雨水極少（little rain），即面臨乾旱，故答案選C。選項A的水災是秘魯周圍地區的狀況，為常見的細節移轉字面陷阱；B地震與D饑荒文中則未提及。

questions.stem: We know the emissions of carbon dioxide have caused global warming, which in turn has posed a great threat to all life. But carbon monoxide is even more dangerous. In winter, a lot of people around the world burn charcoal to keep themselves warm. They may run the risk of carbon monoxide poisoning if ventilation is bad. What is carbon monoxide?
questions.explain:
carbon monoxide: 一氧化碳
emission: 排放物
ventilation: 通風
解析：題意詢問「一氧化碳是什麼？」。文中提到燃燒木炭與通風不良會導致中毒，依常識與文意可知其為氣體，故答案選C。干擾選項A（金屬）、B（植物）及D（液體）均非一氧化碳的物理狀態，屬於物質分類的字面干擾。

questions.stem: Despite facing an imminent labor shortage as its population ages, Japan has done little to open itself up to immigration. Many experts say increasing immigration will definitely provide an obvious remedy to Japan's two decades of slow economic growth. But the Japanese authorities seem determined to do the opposite. They keep encouraging both foreign workers and foreign graduates of its universities to go home. Which of the following may "the Japanese authorities" refer to?
questions.explain:
authorities: 官方當局、政府
imminent: 迫切的、即將發生的
解析：題幹問 the Japanese authorities 指何者。authorities 常指握有公權力的官方或政府機關，故答案選B。選項 A customs（海關或習俗）與 C schools（學校）雖與情境相關，但非國家決策主體，D language（語言）更是無關干擾項。

questions.stem: Scientists around the world have tried to pick up messages from outer space. In the past 50 years, their techniques have grown ever more highly developed. If there are any aliens proclaiming their existence out there, many of the scientists are ready to track them. But as Stephen Hawking recently warned, aliens may be hostile to us. According to Stephen Hawking, aliens may _______.
questions.explain:
outer space: 外太空
hostile: 有敵意的
mean someone harm: 對某人懷有惡意
解析：題幹指出霍金警告外星人對我們可能很 hostile（有敵意的），意即可能傷害人類，故答案選B。選項D的 friendly（友善的）與原文敵意完全相反；選項A做生意與選項C協助發展科學在文中皆未提及，屬於偏離文意的干擾選項。

questions.stem: Many professions have their own words and expressions. This is true for the medical profession. Doctors and nurses use a lot of medical jargon that most people do not understand. But there are also expressions we use every day to tell about a person's health. For instance, when you say you are "under the weather," you may need to go see a doctor. What happens when you are under the weather?

options.A: You are confined by bad weather.
options.C: You are in a bad mood.

questions.explain:
under the weather: 身體不適、生病
medical jargon: 醫學專業術語
confine: 限制、監禁
解析：題幹提及看醫生並詢問 under the weather 的意思，此片語表示身體微恙、不舒服，故答案選D。選項A落入 weather（天氣）的字面陷阱；選項B被誤解與選項C心情差皆不符合健康狀況的文意脈絡。
